answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A willow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the terrace of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the crystal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
